newsitem.title: GERMANY: Allianz to begin operations in China soon.
newsitem.headline: Allianz to begin operations in China soon.

text.p: German insurance group Allianz AG Holding said on Friday that it will soon be able to begin business in China, having just received news from China that a licence to operate there would be granted.

A company spokesman said the group had been informed of the news and would soon agree to a joint-venture with a Chinese partner and enter the life insurance market in China. The spokesman added that Allianz would hold a majority stake in the joint-venture.
Allianz has been attempting to receive a licence to operate in China for some time and in November was tapped by other European insurers as the next likely candidate to receive the necessary permit.
